https://www.brightedge.com/products/brig.description: Google Search Console (GSC) is the most precise research database for Search, showing you the exact words people type into Google to find you. Specifically, it removes the limit Google's interface puts on how many keywords and pages you can see. It keeps a longer look back than Google's own dashboard allows and saves your filters, so you are not rebuilding them every time you open a report. BrightEdge GSC Reporting also connects the dots for you: why clicks dropped even as visibility climbed, which specific keywords and pages are behind any swing and where an AI Overview is quietly taking the click before someone reaches your page. And the best part is that all you need to do is connect Google GSC to your BrightEdge account which takes less than 1 minute.
